title: Print Literal Backslash

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: A backslash '\' must be escaped as '\\' inside string literals to be printed literally.

hints: The backslash character is an escape indicator in most languages.
Use '\\' inside quotes to represent a single literal backslash.
Print the single character followed by a newline.
learningObjectives: Understand backslash escaping mechanics across languages.
Avoid syntax errors caused by unescaped backslashes at end of string literals.
Gain confidence with string literal syntaxes.
